title: Agent Delegation-of-Authority (A-DoA) Decision Record Schema v1.1.0
description: Audit-grade decision record schema for autonomous AI agent actions across Autonomy Tiers T0-T3 and Runtime Suspension Triggers ST-01..ST-05 (Swosti Panda, 2026, CC BY 4.0, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23275115).

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this decision envelope.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the gate evaluation.

agent_id.description: Authenticated identifier of the proposing AI agent.

model_version.description: Identifier and version digest of the underlying model.

policy_version.description: Version or digest of the active A-DoA policy table.

autonomy_tier.description: Evaluated A-DoA autonomy tier (or gating mode) at decision time.

action_type.description: Canonical action class or tool identifier.

resolved_action_digest.description: SHA-256 digest over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical bytes of the resolved action and arguments.

blast_radius_usd.description: Single-action monetary exposure evaluated from master data.

cumulative_24h_usd.description: Rolling 24-hour cumulative monetary commitment across the agent/session.

evidence_refs.description: Immutable references or snapshot digests of inputs consulted.

tripped_trigger.description: ST-01: Aggregate Blast-Radius Exhaustion (>=80% ceiling); ST-02: Human Override/Rejection Spike; ST-03: Upstream Tool/Payload Schema Drift; ST-04: Grounding/Mandate State Deficit; ST-05: Downstream Execution/outcome-unknown Spike.

trigger_evidence.description: Evidence payload when a circuit breaker (ST-01..ST-05) trips or is reset.

rollback_token.description: Idempotency key or pre-computed compensating rollback token.

control_owner.description: Named accountable human control owner (role + identifier).

schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the schema bytes this record was validated against.
